source.scope: all active literal rtSym registrations recursively under bbruntime; internal symbols retained separately by kind

state_definitions.signature_known: decoded public rtSym descriptor; internal symbols have unknown ABI
state_definitions.typed_declaration: name present in samples/Audio/scp.json, including declaration-only entries
state_definitions.executable_binding: assembly/type/method configured and matching managed source method present; does not guarantee assembly built or runtime host available
state_definitions.functional: source implementation evidence only; no universal correctness claim
state_definitions.validated: explicit scoped published comparison; each program is one experiment, not one per function

limitations: Subsystem grouping is a navigation taxonomy inferred from registration module/name.
No C++ preprocessor configuration evaluated; active means outside comments, including conditional registrations.
Literal registration descriptors only; unsupported descriptors and same-name conflicts are retained explicitly.
SCP frequency is lexical identifier occurrence after strings/comments removal, not AST-resolved calls.
Source declarations are historical reference evidence; published captures use the documented original runtime binary version.
Language keywords/intrinsics without rtSym registration are outside this runtime API inventory.

compiler_language_intrinsics.status: not inventoried here; existing compiler core unchanged; an exhaustive language inventory requires a separate phase

third_party_external_declarations.status: separate external integrations, not historical built-in rtSym APIs; the 17 audio rows are built-in Blitz3D audio only
